style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial Pre-Lit Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring instant festive magic into your home with this 6ft artificial pre-lit Christmas tree, designed to make decorating effortless while delivering a beautifully warm seasonal glow. Perfectly full and realistically styled, it creates a stunning centrepiece that captures the spirit of Christmas from the moment it’s switched on. Pre-lit with delicately placed lights throughout the branches, this tree saves you time and effort while ensuring an even, enchanting illumination that enhances every ornament and decoration. The soft glow brings a cosy, inviting atmosphere to your living space, making it the perfect backdrop for festive gatherings and cherished family moments. Standing at an impressive 6ft, it’s ideal for living rooms, hallways or dining areas, offering plenty of presence without overwhelming your space. The lifelike branches provide a natural look and feel, giving you the perfect base to decorate in your own style, whether traditional, elegant or modern. Easy to assemble and designed for repeated use year after year, this pre-lit Christmas tree combines convenience with timeless festive charm, helping you create a beautifully illuminated Christmas with minimal effort and maximum impact. Comes fitted with a standard 3-pin plug. Stand Dims. H15xW51cm.Provide your feedback on BizChat
